comment: This class feels like a social experiment to see how long people can stay awake while taking notes that won't help later. I did all the practice and still felt lost on exams, they seem completely disconnected from what we learn. Be ready to teach yourself most of it.
He does not stop to take a breath!! Long lectures that are impossible to follow, everyone zones out and has no idea what's happening.

Partially through the semester, and before any exams, so wanted to say this without the bias of a grade weighing me down. His lecture style is difficult to follow & he explains concepts in muddled ways. He rarely demonstrates calculations, except when he flashes an excel sheet on the board to model something. Nice man, but I would avoid his class.

Painfully boring. I feel bad for the guy but like come on. Drink a red bull? I'd say its like watching paint dry but that would be a disservice to paint. Overall, it's a strong course, but it's not bad.
Definitely have to work hard in his class. Lectures the whole time but he knows what he's talking about and explains it well. Problem sets aren't too difficult and tests are very straightforward.

He lectures for 75 straight minutes and the poor man barely stops to breathe! Lectures are soo long, but he's very smart - he's clear about the material and walks you through it step by step. Plus his course packet and blackboard handouts are a lifesaver. Lots and lots of info but it's doable and he really seems to want his students to succeed.
He is way too difficult.  Expect to learn most of the material on your own. Very smart guy, not the best teacher.

Professor Szakmary is a good teacher who's very knowledgable on the subject. He only gives 2 tests which aren't too hard if you know how to use the financial calculator. Final Exam is closely related to the tests as well. Other assignments are problem sets that he gives you a week to do. A is very possible. Only problem is lectures are boring.

The man. He can be intimidating in the sense that he knows so much, but he sets very reasonable expectations.He really likes when students ask questions that he can expand upon. Basically its up to you. You can do the work and just get a B+ or you can use him as a resource and exponentially expand your knowledge  of finance. You choose.
The biggest finance boss in RSB.  Definitely worth taking.. anybody who is scared of Szakmary has been misinformed.  He teaches everything so clearly that it's only on yourself if you mess up.

He's great.  He's loves to expand on material that is simplified in the book, but if you stay with him you will aquire knowledge you will need in the future. His exams aren't that bad,study what he talks about and you will have a B at the lowest. If its an A you want, then take advantage of the numerous attachmnts he provides on black board.
